top_signals.title: Ukraine warns of fresh Starshield disruptions as U.S. envoys arrive in Moscow for talks with Putin
top_signals.summary: Starshield is SpaceX's military-grade satellite network designed for government and national security use, building on the technology developed for Starlink.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Rod Little on Edgewell’s Growth
top_signals.summary: Edgewell Personal Care CEO Rod Little joins Bloomberg Open Interest to explain how productivity, fewer promotions, and increased brand advertising helped lift gross margin by 500 basis points. He also discusses value-focused product sizes, private-label shaving, and why growing interest in self-care could benefit its sunscreen business. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
